'''Glimmer Uziel''' was the leader of [[Vicondor/Legends|Vicondor]]. She was in an alliance (resulting in the creation of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] gateway, [[Station 88 Spaceport]]) with [[Lorian Nod]] of [[Junction V]], [[Samish Kash]] of [[Delaluna]], and [[Yura Telamarch]] of [[Bezim]].

Uziel's [[Species/Legends|species]] had pale golden skin and four tiny tentacles that waved in the air, like fronds. She had a musical speaking voice.
